# dsh-relay-isolation

## English

A DeepSeek Harness bundle that provisions **a separate `DSH_HOME`** for a
third-party model relay or

any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so relay traffic never
runs inside your main Harness profile.
### Why a separate home, not just a separate profile

A profile only separates **plugin composition**. Sessions, storages, and
`.credentials.yaml` live in

`DSH_HOME` and are shared by every profile that uses
the same home — so a relay profile in `~/.dsh`

still lists your main
conversations and can read every key you stored. This plugin creates a siblin

ur main
conversations and can read every key you stored. This plugin creates a sibling
home instead:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The isolated home holds **only** `AGENTROUTER_API_KEY`; other credentials are
never copied.
### Install

### Use
The bundle registers one agent tool, `relay_isolation`:
| action | what it does |
| `status` | reports whether the isolated home exists, whether its profile is configured, whether th

e relay route is installed, whether a key is present |
| `setup` | creates or refreshes it; idempote

nt |
| `remove` | deletes it, including the sessions stored there; requires `force: true` |

Ask your agent: *"create an isolated relay environment"* — it calls
`relay_isolation` with `action:

"setup"`. On Windows a double-click launcher is
written to the Desktop; elsewhere `~/.dsh-relay/laun

ch.sh` is written and made
executable.

The launcher installs `dsh-llm-agentrouter` into the isolated profile on first
start, then boots `ds
h` with `--port 0` and opens its own UI.
### What it generates
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The relay route and its request compatibility (client `User-Agent`, direct
transport for the domesti

c endpoint, tool-schema repair) come from
`dsh-llm-agentrouter`. This
plugin configures it; it does

hema repair) come from
`dsh-llm-agentrouter`. This
plugin configures it; it does not reimplement it.
### Network inside the sandbox

The Windows sandbox hands shell commands a token without network capability, so
`curl` inside the is

olated environment cannot reach anything. Raising the mode
to `danger-full-access` would fix that by
removing the sandbox — the wrong trade.

Instead the bundle registers a second tool, `relay_fetch`, which performs the
request **in the host
process** (unsandboxed) against an explicit allowlist:
| Host | Why |

| `registry.npmjs.org` | package metadata and tarballs |
| `api.github.com`, `github.com`, `raw.gith

ubusercontent.com` | repository discovery and file reads |
| `cdn.jsdelivr.net`, `awesome-dsh-plugin
.com`, `dshmarket.com` | plugin catalog |

GET only, HTTPS only, 60 KB per call by default, 20 s timeout. The write boundary
is unchanged: the
sandbox still confines the agent to its workspace.
Configuration:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Permissions it gets

The isolated environment is provisioned to be **useful inside its box and unable
to reach outside it

isolated environment is provisioned to be **useful inside its box and unable
to reach outside it**:
| Capability | Default | Detail |
| Workspace read/write | yes | The launcher `cd`s into `<home>/workspace`; the sandbox pins `workspa

ceRoot` to that directory |
| Command execution | yes | Sandboxed; approval `ask` fails closed when

nobody answers |
| Outbound npm / GitHub | yes | Needed to install the relay route; model traffic al

ready goes to the relay |
| Credentials | only `AGENTROUTER_API_KEY` | Other keys in the main home a

relay |
| Credentials | only `AGENTROUTER_API_KEY` | Other keys in the main home are never copied |

**What it does not guarantee:** DSH's `workspace-write` bounds *writes*, not
*reads*. An agent insid

e the isolated environment can still read paths outside
its workspace. For a real boundary, run the

launcher as a separate OS user or in
a VM.
### Relay-side limits

The Responses API is stateful: a follow-up request may reference an item created
by the previous one

. A relay that spreads requests across several upstream
resources breaks that, and the upstream answ

ers *"The requested item was created
under a different Azure OpenAI resource"*. No profile setting f

ixes this — the
relay has to pin a conversation to one upstream. Note also that `supportsStore`
is a

completions-only switch: `openai-responses` rejects it and accepts
`supportsDeveloperRole`, `suppor

tsMaxOutputTokens`, `supportsStrictMode`,
`supportsLongCacheRetention`.
### Limits

- It cannot isolate the **running** host: `DSH_HOME` is fixed when a process
starts. Isolation appli

es to the environment it provisions.
- The generated profile is `relay`; the generated home is
`$(di

rname $DSH_HOME)/.dsh-<suffix>`.
- Installing the relay package needs network access on first launch

.
- `remove` deletes that home, including its sessions. It refuses to run without
`force: true`, and
refuses to delete `DSH_HOME` itself.
## 中文

一个 DeepSeek Harness bundle，给第三方模型中转站（AgentRouter）**单独开一个
`DSH_HOME`**，让中转站流量不进入主 Harness profile。
### 中转站侧的限制

Responses API 是有状态的：后续请求可能引用上一跳创建的 item。如果中转站把请求分散到多个
上游资源上，这一点就会被打破，上游会回 *"The requested item was c

reated under a different
Azure OpenAI resource"*。**这不是配置能修的**——得让中转站把同一段对话固定到同一个上游。
另外 `supportsStor

e` 是 completions 专有开关，`openai-responses` 不接受，它只接受
`supportsDeveloperRole`、`supportsMaxOutputTokens`、

`supportsStrictMode`、
`supportsLongCacheRetention`。
